chassis.note: Half-width 1RU, 221 x 44 x 235 - the data sheets' "1.75' (1RU) x 8.7' x 9.25' (44mm x 221mm x 235mm)". The stencil master's own outline, which has no ears (a half-width box), is 221.25 x 43.79 and agrees to a quarter of a millimetre; the chassis carries the data sheet's figures. "19' rack and wall-mounting options" (2019 edition) - the brackets are not part of the face.

eth-speed.note: BORROWED, NOT STATED. The data sheets list "1 x Console RJ45 port" and are silent on the ETH management port's rate. 1g is taken from the TM-8104's OOB port on the maintainer's ruling for unstated management rates; the eth-speed gap stays open.

front-layout.note: POSITIONS ARE THE RENDER'S, SHAPES THE STENCIL'S. telco.com 2024/09/TMC3348S-E.png is rectified by a four-corner homography onto the data sheet's 221 x 44 (corners TL 5,106.5 TR 1194,113.5 BR 1193,329 BL 5,328.5; about 5.4 px/mm, good to a few tenths of a millimetre) and every jack, cage, lamp, slot, vent and grille is placed where it lands. The NetZoom master TMC-3348S (CF) is retired for positions: its copper jacks sit on a 16.7 pitch where this render measures 14.1, and its blocks are 0.5-4 mm from where the render puts them. The stencil keeps its legends and the cage and jack shapes. THE TM-3312's RENDER DOES NOT AGREE WITH THIS ONE CLOSELY on the shared left half, although the two faces are presumably one part: relative positions differ by up to about 1.3 mm in x (ETH to the first SFP column is 81.1 here and 82.35 on the TM-3312) and 0.5-1.1 mm in y, and the pitches differ (copper 14.1 here against 14.25, SFP 14.45 against 14.3). This render is 5.4 px/mm against the TM-3312's 2.3, so where they disagree this one is the likelier to be right; nothing held settles it.

jack-lamps.note: The render shows two lamp windows on the CON console, and the STS and FLT legends printed under it name them. CON is not Ethernet, so it is the bare std/rj45-ganged@2 with the two windows placed beside it as common/led-rect-sm@1, for: con, at the corners where common/rj45-ganged-eth@1 draws its own - the family's way of drawing a lamped non-Ethernet jack (juniper/mx204's BITS).

lamps.note: SYNC, SD, PS1 and PS2 are about 4 mm lamps with a pinhole between SD and PS1, placed where the rectified render has them, as are the wordmark plate, the four short slots under the model name and the vent dashes along the top edge (none of which the stencil draws); LNK/ACT and MNG are printed over the ETH jack and STS and FLT under the CON jack, naming those jacks' own lamp windows. No document says what any state means.

model.note: TM-3348S/SH data sheet (telco.com 2025/12), "10GE Ethernet/MPLS/IP Aggregation & Demarcation Device"; the 2024 edition calls it the T-Marc 3348S/SH, and the face prints TMC-3348 S.

ports.note: Copper 1/1-1/4 (columns 63.35 and 77.45) are a 2 x 2 RJ45 block with lamp windows in their outer corners, common/rj45-ganged-eth@1, upper row turned 180. SFP 2/1-2/8 are a 2 x 4 stacked block on a 14.4 pitch (columns 95.95-139.25) with TWO arrow lamps per port in the strip between the rows, ▼▲▼▲ across each column at -4.75, -1.9, +1.8 and +4.65 mm from the column centre. SFP+ 3/1-3/4 are one row of four under four slotted vent grilles, each with a lamp dot beside its legend; a LICENSE bracket spans 3/3 and 3/4, which the ordering table says need "Activation license ... for ports 3 & 4". The ETH legend's bracket runs under 1/1-2/8 and on under 3/1 and 3/2, with the word printed off-centre at about 134 mm where the render has it; 3/3 and 3/4 each have a bracket of their own under the LICENSE one - so the face groups 3/1-3/2 with the Ethernet ports and sets the licensed pair apart.

power.note: Two internal supplies, AC (TMC-3348S-2AC-x) or DC (TMC-3348S-2DC); "Redundant power supplies and wide-range DC input". Input "100-240 VAC, 50/60 Hz -24/48VDC to-72VDC" (both editions), and the ordering table rates the DC model "Dual feed -24/-48 VDC 3A power supplies" - recorded as stated, in volts and amps, on the dc-power configuration. No consumption figure in watts is published. The supplies are internal, so the front carries no bays; their inlets are presumably at the rear.

sources.note: Two data-sheet editions (2024-05, 2025-12), twelve vendor images of which telco.com 2024/09/TMC3348S-E.png (1200 x 331, near square-on, about 5.4 px/mm) is the best of any T-Series model, and the legacy NetZoom stencil "Telco Systems" (2022), master TMC-3348S (CF). No installation guide is public.
